storeInfo.name: Tacos Mexico
storeInfo.tagline: Authentic Mexican flavors and fresh street tacos right in the heart of Norwalk / Sabor auténtico mexicano en Norwalk

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Aguacates Hass machacados al momento con cilantro, tomate, cebolla y un toque de limón. Servido con totopos de maíz crujientes.
products.descriptionEn: Freshly mashed Hass avocados with cilantro, tomato, onion, and a squeeze of lime. Served with crispy corn tortilla chips.

products.descriptionEs: Queso Oaxaca y Monterey Jack derretido al horno con chorizo mexicano picante, servido con tortillas de maíz calientes.
products.descriptionEn: Oaxaca and Monterey Jack cheese baked to bubbly perfection with spicy Mexican chorizo, served with warm corn tortillas.

products.descriptionEs: Gruesas tortillas de maíz con bordes levantados, untadas con frijoles refritos, carne deshebrada, lechuga, crema y queso fresco.
products.descriptionEn: Thick corn masa bases pinched at the edges, layered with refried beans, shredded meat, lettuce, crema, and queso fresco.

products.descriptionEs: Suaves tortillas de maíz con tu elección de carne (asada, al pastor, carnitas o pollo), cebolla, cilantro fresco, salsa y limón.
products.descriptionEn: Soft corn tortillas loaded with your choice of meat (steak, marinated pork, pork shoulder, or chicken), onion, fresh cilantro, salsa, and lime.

products.descriptionEs: Tres tortillas de maíz enrolladas con pollo deshebrado, bañadas en salsa verde casera, crema agria y queso fresco gratinado.
products.descriptionEn: Three corn tortillas rolled with shredded chicken, smothered in tangy house-made green tomatillo salsa, sour cream, and melted cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Tortilla de harina gigante rellena de arroz mexicano, frijoles negros, carne asada, queso, guacamole y crema agria.
products.descriptionEn: Giant flour tortilla stuffed with Mexican rice, black beans, grilled steak, melted cheese, guacamole, and sour cream.

products.descriptionEs: Jugoso filete de arrachera a la parrilla, acompañado de una enchilada roja, guacamole, frijoles de la olla y cebollitas asadas.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy grilled skirt steak served with a cheese enchilada, guacamole, whole pinto beans, and charred green onions.

products.descriptionEs: Carne asada, pollo a la parrilla, chorizo, queso fresco, nopal y chiles toreados servidos hirviendo en un mortero de piedra volcánica.
products.descriptionEn: Grilled steak, chicken, chorizo, queso fresco, cactus paddle, and jalapeños sizzling in a hot volcanic rock mortar.

products.descriptionEs: Camarones salteados en una salsa de chiles rojos picantes y ahumados. Servido con arroz blanco y ensalada fresca.
products.descriptionEn: Shrimp sautéed in a fiery, smoky red chili pepper sauce. Served with seasoned white rice and a crisp side salad.
Traditional house-made rice beverage blended with milk, vanilla, and a fragrant touch of cinnamon.
Classic Mexican soda sweetened with natural cane sugar. Flavors: Mandarin, Tamarind, or Pineapple.

products.descriptionEs: Tequila 100% de agave, Cointreau y jugo de limón fresco recién exprimido, servido con borde de sal marina.
products.descriptionEn: 100% agave tequila, Cointreau, and freshly squeezed lime juice, served over ice with a sea salt rim.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, tenemos varias opciones con tortillas de maíz que son naturalmente sin gluten y platos vegetarianos.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer several corn tortilla items which are naturally gluten-free, alongside dedicated vegetarian dishes.

faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations or takeout orders?
faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y también puede ordenar para llevar llamando directamente al restaurante.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins for dining and you can also place takeout orders by calling the restaurant directly.
